_readme: Known symbols for ES1's DBSIM.EXE (ES1DBSIM): confirmed address -> meaning mappings, applied to the ES1Recon Ghidra project by ES2ApplySymbolNames.java.
Addresses are offsets into the flat X-32 image (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/x32-executable.md#the-image).
Schema, confidence rules and run order: tools/ghidra_scripts/README.md, 'Known symbols'.
Entries are in address order. tools/scripts/es2_naming.py insert and edit keep it, and check that it holds.

entries.name: X32_AllocMemory
entries.description: (size), C convention: rounds size up to a multiple of 0x1000 and asks the extender for that much memory (INT 21h AX=350Ch). On carry it returns -1; otherwise it stores EDX at 00090024, raises the high-water mark 00090028 to the block's end when the end is above it, and returns the block's address. Mem_InitHeap takes the heap's block from it, and operator new and malloc fall back on it while the heap is off.

entries.name: __x386_coproc_init
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__x386_coproc_init`, from `x386.asm`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 86 bytes from here.

entries.name: Heap_Init
entries.description: (heap, block, size), callee-cleaned: sets up the heap object over the block: +0 base, +4 the size as given, +8 the free list (the block, its next link zeroed), and +0xc (free bytes) and +0x10 (their low mark) the size rounded down to a multiple of 8, which also becomes the block's size. Tags the block FBLK at +8.

entries.name: Heap_IsBlock
entries.description: (heap, block header): 1 when the address lies from the heap's base to 0x10 bytes before its end and carries a block tag (FBLK at +8 or ABLK at +0), else 0.

entries.name: Heap_Alloc
entries.description: (heap, trackLow, size), callee-cleaned: first-fit allocation. Returns 0 for size 0. Rounds size + 8 up to a multiple of 8 and walks the free list (+8): a block of exactly that size is unlinked; a block more than 0x10 bytes larger is split, the tail staying on the list tagged FBLK; a block larger by 0x10 or less is passed over. The block is tagged ABLK, its payload zero-filled, its size taken off the free bytes (+0xc), and with trackLow set the low mark (+0x10) lowered to the free bytes. Returns the payload (header + 8), or 0 when no block fits.

entries.name: Heap_Free
entries.description: (heap, payload), callee-cleaned: nothing for a null payload. Adds the block's size back to the free bytes (+0xc), tags it FBLK, inserts it into the free list (+8) in address order, and merges it with the free block before it and the one after it where they touch.

entries.name: Heap_Realloc
entries.description: (heap, size, payload), callee-cleaned: size 0 frees the block (Heap_Free) and returns 0. A smaller size gives the tail back in place: to the free block that follows when there is one, otherwise as a new block freed through Heap_Free when the tail exceeds 0x10 bytes, and by moving the data into a new block (Heap_Alloc, memmove, Heap_Free) when it does not. A larger size takes the difference from a following free block large enough for it, and otherwise moves the data. The block after it is checked with Heap_IsBlock and its predecessor on the free list found with Heap_FindPrevFree. Lowers the low mark (+0x10) to the free bytes. Returns the payload, moved or not, or 0 when a move cannot allocate.

entries.name: Heap_FindPrevFree
entries.description: (heap, block): the free block whose next link is the given block, walking the list from +8; 0 when the block heads the list or the walk ends without finding it.

entries.name: Mem_InitHeap
entries.description: (size): caps size at X32_LargestFreeBlock() - 25000, takes a block that large from X32_AllocMemory, asserting 'Memory alloc failed' (memory.cpp line 504, severity 5) through Assert_Report when it returns -1, makes it the heap 000ae4ac (Heap_Init) and sets 000901d4, which sends operator new, malloc and the frees to the heap.

entries.name: Mem_HeapOff
entries.description: Clears 000901d4, after which operator new and malloc take memory from X32_AllocMemory and the frees do nothing.

entries.name: operator_new
entries.description: The game's operator new (size), callee-cleaned (RET 4): Heap_Alloc(000ae4ac, 1, size) while 000901d4 is set, otherwise X32_AllocMemory(size) with -1 returned as 0. It is the allocation a constructor makes for a null this (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/compiler.md#constructors-and-destructors). malloc is the same body with the C convention.

entries.name: Mem_AllocFromHeap
entries.description: (heap, size), callee-cleaned (RET 8): Heap_Alloc(heap, 1, size) on the heap it is given.

entries.name: operator_delete
entries.description: The game's operator delete (pointer), callee-cleaned (RET 4): Heap_Free(000ae4ac, pointer) while 000901d4 is set, otherwise nothing. It is the release a destructor makes when bit 0 of its flags is set (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/compiler.md#constructors-and-destructors). free is the same body with the C convention.

entries.name: malloc
entries.description: The game's malloc (size), C convention: operator_new's body, returning with a plain RET. It is the _malloc of the startup's argument vector (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/compiler.md#startup).

entries.name: free
entries.description: The game's free (pointer), C convention: operator_delete's body, returning with a plain RET.

entries.name: realloc
entries.description: The game's realloc (pointer, size), C convention: Heap_Realloc(000ae4ac, size, pointer), whether or not 000901d4 is set.

entries.name: calloc
entries.description: The game's calloc (count, size), C convention: count * size bytes from Heap_Alloc(000ae4ac, 1, ...) while 000901d4 is set, otherwise from X32_AllocMemory with -1 returned as 0, then memset to zero over the block's size from the header at payload-4, less 8. A block from X32_AllocMemory has no header, so that size is read from the 4 bytes before it.

entries.name: VolRStream_Ctor
entries.description: VolRStream() constructor, callee-cleaned (this): allocates 0x2f bytes through operator_new when this is null (0 if that fails), Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 0009683e at +4, clears the filters +0x27 and +0x2b and the entry fields +0xa, +0xe and +0x16, handle -1 at +8 and status 5 at +0. ES2's VolRStream_Ctor (DBSIM 00472d60).

entries.name: VolRStream_CtorFromHandle
entries.description: VolRStream(handle) constructor, callee-cleaned: VolRStream_Ctor's allocation and clearing, then adopts the handle at +8 without owning it (+0x26 = 0) and probes it with lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR), VolRStream_SetIoError on -1. ES2's VolRStream_CtorFromHandle (DBSIM 00472da8).

entries.name: VolRStream_CtorFromPath
entries.description: VolRStream(path) constructor, callee-cleaned: allocates 0x2f bytes when this is null, Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 0009683e, clears +0x27, +0x2b, +0xa, +0xe, +0x16, handle -1, +0x26 cleared, then VolRStream_Open(path). ES2's VolRStream_CtorFromPath (DBSIM 00472e08).

entries.name: VolRStream_Dtor
entries.description: VolRStream destructor (this, flags), vtable slot +4: restores the vtable 0009683e, deletes the filters at +0x27 and +0x2b through their own slot +4 with flags 3, VolRStream_Close, Stream_BaseDtor(this, 0), and operator_delete when bit 0 of the flags is set. ES2's VolRStream_Dtor (DBSIM 00472e58).

entries.name: VolRStream_SetFile
entries.description: (stream, handle): VolRStream_Close, adopts the handle at +8 without owning it (+0x26 = 0) and probes it with lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR): status 0 on success, VolRStream_SetIoError on -1. ES2's VolRStream_SetFile (DBSIM 00472f30).

entries.name: VolRStream_Close
entries.description: (stream): closes the handle at +8 when the stream owns it (+0x26) and it is not -1, returning 0 with status 3 when close fails; passes the RLE filter +0x27 to 0007509c and the LZH filter +0x2b to 00074ccc when set; clears +0xa, +0xe and +0x16, sets the handle to -1 and status 5, and returns 1. ES2's VolRStream_Close (DBSIM 00472f70).

entries.name: VolRStream_Open
entries.description: (stream, path): VolRStream_Close, clears +0xa, +0xe and +0x16, then open(path, 0) into the handle at +8. When that fails it looks the path up in the volume group 00096838 through 000566b8, which fills the entry fields from +0xa; with no group or no entry it sets status 1 and returns. By the entry's compression type at +0x1e it reads through: 2, the volume's stream itself (+0xe = +0xa); 7, the RLE filter at +0x27 (made by 00074f9c on first use and attached by 00075068); 9, the LZH filter at +0x2b (00074b8c, 00074c70). Then status 0 and +0x26 = 1, also for a volume entry. ES2's VolRStream_Open (DBSIM 00472fdc).

entries.name: VolRStream_SetGroup
entries.description: (a, b, c, d): makes the volume group 00096838 through 00056180(0, a, b, c, d) on first use, otherwise passes the same arguments to 000562d8 on it. ES2's VolRStream_SetGroup (DBSIM 00473154).

entries.name: VolRStream_LoadVolume
entries.description: (path): passes the path to 00056620 on the volume group 00096838. ES2's VolRStream_LoadVolume (DBSIM 00473210).

entries.name: VolRStream_GetSize
entries.description: (stream): filelength of the handle at +8 when there is one, otherwise the entry size +0x22 when an entry is open (+0xe), else 0. ES2's VolRStream_GetSize (DBSIM 00473228).

entries.name: VolRStream_GetPosition
entries.description: VolRStream vtable slot +8 (stream): lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR) for a file handle, the position in the entry (+0x16) when one is open, else 0. ES2's VolRStream_GetPosition (DBSIM 0047325c).

entries.name: VolRStream_SetPosition
entries.description: VolRStream vtable slot +0xc (stream, position): a status of 2 is cleared first, and any other nonzero status returns 0. A file handle seeks with lseek(h, position, SEEK_SET), VolRStream_SetIoError on -1. An open entry stores the position at +0x16 and at +0x1a the absolute offset +0x12 + position, or, when the position is not below the size +0x22, the size itself with status 2,; type 2 seeks the volume stream there, and types 7 and 9 reset their filter (0007509c, 00074ccc), seek the volume stream to the entry's start, re-attach the filter (00075068, 00074c70) and seek the filter to the position. Returns 1 otherwise. ES2's VolRStream_SetPosition (DBSIM 00473298).

entries.name: VolRStream_GetCapabilities
entries.description: VolRStream vtable slot +0x10 (stream, query): for a file handle, query 0 answers 2 and queries 2 and 3 answer 1; for a volume entry, query 0 answers the compression type +0x1e, 2 and 3 answer 1 and 4 answers whether the type is not 2. Anything else answers 0. ES2's VolRStream_GetCapabilities (DBSIM 00473404).

entries.name: VolRStream_Flush
entries.description: VolRStream vtable slot +0x14, which enters through the padding at 00056d2a: MOV AL,1; RET 4. ES2's VolRStream_Flush (DBSIM 0047346c).

entries.name: VolRStream_SetIoError
entries.description: (stream): sets the status at +0 to 3 when errno (000973d3) is 0, otherwise 1, and returns 0. ES2's VolRStream_SetIoError (DBSIM 00473474).

entries.name: VolRStream_Write
entries.description: VolRStream vtable slot +0x18: sets status 4 and returns 0. ES2's VolRStream_Write (DBSIM 00473498).

entries.name: VolRStream_Read
entries.description: VolRStream vtable slot +0x1c (stream, buffer, count): 0 when the status is nonzero, 1 for a count of 0. A file handle reads through read(), VolRStream_SetIoError on -1 and status 2 with 0 returned on a short read. An entry first re-seeks (slot +0xc to +0x16) when the volume stream's position no longer equals +0x1a. A read running past the entry size +0x22 sets status 2, reads size - position + 1 bytes from the volume stream at +0xa itself, sets +0x16 to size + 1 and returns 0; any other reads count bytes through +0xe (the volume stream or the filter), adds count to +0x16 and returns 1. Both update +0x1a to the volume stream's position. The inner reads' results are not tested. ES2's VolRStream_Read (DBSIM 004734ac).

entries.name: Assert_Emit
entries.description: (message, line, file, condition, severity) in stack order, callee-cleaned (RET 0x14), switching on severity: 1 prints 'Assert: %d warning%s logged.' to the stream 0009e87c when the warning count 000b5b50 is not 0, the 's' left off for one; 2 passes the message to 00056f30; 3 counts a warning (000b5b50) and passes the line 00056e84 formats to 00056f30; 4 does the same without counting and also writes the line and a newline to 0009e87c; 5 writes 'Internal Error:' and a request to call Sierra customer support (000968ec), then the message, to 0009e87c; 6 passes 'Assert::break: Ctrl-C / Ctrl-Break' to 00056f30 and writes it to 0009e87c. Other severities do nothing. ES2's Assert_Emit (DBSIM 00479e18) is the counterpart.

entries.name: Assert_RunHooks
entries.description: (logger, severity), callee-cleaned: calls each hook on the list at 000b5b58 (+0 next, +4 the function) with the severity. ES2's Assert_RunHooks (DBSIM 00479b48) is the counterpart.

entries.name: Assert_Report
entries.description: (logger, message, line, file, condition, severity) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the member function Assert_Report(severity, condition, file, line, message) of ES2 (DBSIM 00479b6c), with the logger 000b5b54 as this. Severities 4, 5 and 6 are fatal: with 000b5bcc set it executes INT 3 and returns; otherwise it runs the hooks (Assert_RunHooks), emits the assert (Assert_Emit), emits severity 1 (the warning summary) and ends the program through __exit(1). Any other severity is only emitted.

entries.name: __cinit
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__cinit`, from `cinit.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 33 bytes from here.

entries.name: __exit
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__exit`, from `cinit.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 9 bytes from here.

entries.name: ___faterr
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `___faterr`, from `cinit.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 32 bytes from here.

entries.name: Math_Q8Multiply
entries.description: (int a, int16 b), C convention: Q8 multiply rounded to nearest. IMUL of a by the sign-extended b, then SBB/XOR adds 0x80 when the product fits in 32 bits and 0xffffff7f when it does not, and SHRD EAX,EDX,8. ES2's Math_Q8Multiply (DBSIM 0047df94) truncates.

entries.name: Math_Q10Multiply
entries.description: (int a, int16 b), C convention: Q10 multiply rounded to nearest. Math_Q8Multiply's body with 0x200 (0xfffffdff when the product overflows 32 bits) and a shift of 10. ES2's Math_Q10Multiply (DBSIM 0047dfa4) truncates.

entries.name: Math_Q14Multiply
entries.description: (int a, int16 b), C convention: Q14 multiply rounded to nearest. Math_Q8Multiply's body with 0x2000 (0xffffdfff when the product overflows 32 bits) and a shift of 14. ES2's Math_Q14Multiply (DBSIM 0047dfb4) truncates.

entries.name: vfprintf
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `vfprintf`, from `printf.c`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 27 bytes from here.

entries.name: __DOSIGN
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__DOSIGN`, from `printf.c`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 48 bytes from here.

entries.name: memmove
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `memmove`, from `strings.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 79 bytes from here.

entries.name: memcmp
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `memcmp`, from `strings.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 37 bytes from here.

entries.name: memset
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `memset`, from `strings.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 49 bytes from here.

entries.name: __dosx_get_abs_address
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__dosx_get_abs_address`, from `funcs32.asm`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 24 bytes from here.

entries.name: __x386_map_physical_address
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__x386_map_physical_address`, from `funcs32.asm`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 61 bytes from here.

entries.name: X32_LargestFreeBlock
entries.description: No arguments, C convention: the larger of the extender's figure (INT 21h AX=350Bh, in EAX) less the part of the current 4 KB page above the high-water mark 00090028, and the largest size (+4) on the circular list headed at the pointer 0009002c; minus 4, or 0 when that would go below 0. Mem_InitHeap caps the heap's size with it.

entries.name: Math_FastMagnitude3D
entries.description: (a, b, c), C convention: the square-root-free magnitude L + M*0.34375 + S*0.25 over the sorted absolute values (S >> 2, M >> 2 + M >> 4 + M >> 5). Its 72 bytes are ES2's Math_FastMagnitude3D (DBSIM 0047dd66) byte for byte.

entries.name: Math_RandomSeed
entries.description: (state), callee-cleaned: sets the cursors +0x70 to 0x18 and +0x71 to 0x37 and copies the 112-byte seed table 00098150 over the state's 56 shorts. Calls nothing else, where ES2's Math_RandomSeed (DBSIM 00492d7c) goes on to an empty function.

entries.name: Math_RandomNext
entries.description: (state), callee-cleaned: ES2's additive lagged Fibonacci generator (Math_RandomNext, DBSIM 00492dd4). table[+0x71] += table[+0x70] over the 56 shorts at the state's start; returns the new table[+0x71], then advances both cursors, each wrapping from 56 to 0.

entries.name: Math_RandomBelow
entries.description: (state, int16 bound), callee-cleaned: (Math_RandomNext(state) & 0x7fff) % bound, as ES2's Math_RandomBelow (DBSIM 00492e18).

entries.name: Math_DistanceBetweenPoints
entries.description: (a, b), two int32 triples, callee-cleaned: Math_FastMagnitude3D of the three component differences, subtracted in line. ES2's Math_DistanceBetweenPoints (DBSIM 00492780) copies and subtracts through Vec3_Subtract.

entries.name: Math_Atan2Guarded
entries.description: (x, y) in source order (y at [ebp+8], x at [ebp+0xc]), callee-cleaned: sets x to 1 when x and y are both 0, then returns Math_Atan2Bam(x, y), its EAX passed through. ES2's Math_Atan2Guarded (DBSIM 00492800).

entries.name: Math_HeadingToward
entries.description: (to, from) in source order (from at [ebp+8], to at [ebp+0xc]), callee-cleaned: Math_Atan2Guarded(to.x - from.x, to.y - from.y) less a quarter turn (ADD AX,0xc000). ES2's Math_HeadingToward (DBSIM 00492828), which also takes the destination first.

entries.name: Math_CountdownTimerTick
entries.description: (record), callee-cleaned: the short at record+1 less the short at 000bdbd0, set to 0 when negative, and returned in AX. ES2's Math_CountdownTimerTick (DBSIM 00467944) subtracts SimTickDelta.

entries.name: ltoa
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `ltoa`, from `itoa.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 89 bytes from here.

entries.name: Math_CosBam
entries.description: (int16 angle), C convention: cosine of a binary angle in Q14 from the quarter-turn table 000981cc: the angle rounded to a step of 16 ((a >> 4) plus bit 3), its magnitude i, then table[i] below 0x400 and -table[0x800 - i] from there. ES2's Math_CosBam (DBSIM 0047dee4) but for the table's address.

entries.name: strcat
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `strcat`, from `strings.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 65 bytes from here.

entries.name: Stream_BaseCtor
entries.description: StreamIO constructor, callee-cleaned (this): allocates 8 bytes through operator_new when this is null (0 if that fails), installs the vtable 000989d2 at +4 and clears the status at +0. ES2's Stream_BaseCtor (DBSIM 0047a77c).

entries.name: Stream_BaseDtor
entries.description: StreamIO destructor (this, flags), vtable slot +4: restores the vtable 000989d2, calls StreamIO_Flush directly, through the padding at 00064d69, and operator_delete when bit 0 of the flags is set. ES2's counterpart is Stream_BaseDtor (DBSIM 0047a798).

entries.name: StreamIO_GetCapabilities
entries.description: StreamIO vtable slot +0x10 (stream, query), entered through the padding at 00064d3e: a jump table at 000989f8 for queries 0-4 whose five entries all go to the code that returns 0, as other queries do. Answers 0 to everything, as ES2's StreamIO_GetCapabilities (DBSIM 0047a7c8).

entries.name: StreamIO_GetPosition
entries.description: StreamIO vtable slot +8, entered through the padding at 00064d5a: XOR EAX,EAX; RET 4.

entries.name: StreamIO_SetPosition
entries.description: StreamIO vtable slot +0xc, entered through the padding at 00064d61: MOV AL,1; RET 8.

entries.name: StreamIO_Flush
entries.description: StreamIO vtable slot +0x14, entered through the padding at 00064d69, where Ghidra starts its function: MOV AL,1; RET 4. Stream_BaseDtor calls 00064d69.

entries.name: StreamIO_Write
entries.description: StreamIO vtable slot +0x18, entered through the padding at 00064d71: MOV AL,1; RET 0xC.

entries.name: StreamIO_Read
entries.description: StreamIO vtable slot +0x1c, entered through the padding at 00064d79: MOV AL,1; RET 0xC.

entries.name: FileRStream_CtorDefault
entries.description: FileRStream() constructor, callee-cleaned (this): allocates 0xb bytes when this is null (0 if that fails), Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 00098a76 at +4, handle -1 at +8, status 5 and +0xa (owns the handle) cleared. ES2's FileRStream_CtorDefault (DBSIM 0047abb8).

entries.name: FileRStream_CtorFromHandle
entries.description: FileRStream(handle) constructor, callee-cleaned: allocates 0xb bytes when this is null, Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 00098a76, adopts the handle at +8 without owning it (+0xa = 0) and probes it with lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR), FileRStream_SetIoError on -1. ES2's FileRStream_CtorFromHandle (DBSIM 0047abec).

entries.name: FileRStream_Ctor
entries.description: FileRStream(path) constructor, callee-cleaned: allocates 0xb bytes when this is null, Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 00098a76, handle -1, +0xa cleared, then FileRStream_Open(path). ES2's FileRStream_Ctor (DBSIM 0047ac34).

entries.name: FileRStream_Dtor
entries.description: FileRStream destructor (this, flags), vtable slot +4: restores the vtable 00098a76, FileRStream_Close, Stream_BaseDtor(this, 0), and operator_delete when bit 0 of the flags is set. ES2's FileRStream_Dtor (DBSIM 0047ac6c).

entries.name: FileRStream_GetCapabilities
entries.description: FileRStream vtable slot +0x10 (stream, query): query 0 answers 2, queries 2 and 3 answer 1, anything else 0. ES2's FileRStream_GetCapabilities (DBSIM 0047aca8).

entries.name: FileRStream_SetFile
entries.description: (stream, handle): FileRStream_Close, adopts the handle at +8 without owning it (+0xa = 0) and probes it with lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR): status 0 on success, FileRStream_SetIoError on -1. ES2's FileRStream_SetFile (DBSIM 0047acd8).

entries.name: FileRStream_Close
entries.description: (stream): closes the handle at +8 when the stream owns it (+0xa) and it is not -1, returning 0 with status 3 when close fails; otherwise sets the handle to -1 and status 5 and returns 1. ES2's FileRStream_Close (DBSIM 0047ad1c).

entries.name: FileRStream_Open
entries.description: (stream, path): FileRStream_Close, then open(path, 0) into the handle at +8: status 1 and 0 returned on failure, else status 0, +0xa (owns the handle) set and 1 returned. ES2's FileRStream_Open (DBSIM 0047ad5c).

entries.name: FileRStream_Tell
entries.description: FileRStream vtable slot +8 (stream): returns lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR) of the handle at +8. ES2's FileRStream_Tell (DBSIM 0047ada4).

entries.name: FileRStream_Seek
entries.description: FileRStream vtable slot +0xc (stream, position): a status of 2 is cleared first and any other nonzero status returns 0; lseek(h, position, SEEK_SET), FileRStream_SetIoError on -1, else 1. ES2's FileRStream_Seek (DBSIM 0047adc0).

entries.name: FileRStream_GetSize
entries.description: (stream): 0 unless the status is 0 or 2. Otherwise saves the position (slot +8), takes lseek(h, 0, SEEK_END), restores the position (slot +0xc) and returns the end offset. ES2's FileRStream_GetSize (DBSIM 0047ae04).

entries.name: FileRStream_Flush
entries.description: FileRStream vtable slot +0x14, entered through the padding at 00065806: MOV AL,1; RET 4. ES2's FileRStream_Flush (DBSIM 0047ae4c).

entries.name: FileRStream_SetIoError
entries.description: (stream): sets the status at +0 to 3 when errno (000973d3) is 0, otherwise 1, and returns 0. ES2's FileRStream_SetIoError (DBSIM 0047ae54).

entries.name: FileRStream_Write
entries.description: FileRStream vtable slot +0x18: sets status 4 and returns 0. ES2's FileRStream_Write (DBSIM 0047ae78).

entries.name: FileRStream_Read

entries.name: Math_Atan2Bam
entries.description: (x, y), C convention: atan2 as a 16-bit binary angle. The smaller magnitude shifted left 9, plus half the larger, divided by the larger gives a quotient q; q is 0 or q*4 plus the byte table 0009e648[q]. When |y| > |x| the angle is 0x1000 minus that; a negative x makes it 0x2000 minus the angle and a negative y 0x4000 minus it; the result is shifted left 2 and masked to 16 bits. A y of 0 gives 0, or 0x8000 with x negative. ES2's Math_Atan2Bam (DBSIM 0047d220) with its PUSH EBX/POP EBX left out, so EBX is overwritten.
